message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine relation between two yes/no questions.

Question1: "O Projeto de Lei nº 2.768, que regula as plataformas digitais, deve ser aprovado?" (Should PL 2768, which regulates digital platforms, be approved?)

Question2: "A proposta de regulamentação dos mercados digitais (PL 2768/22) deve ser aprovada?" (Should the proposal to regulate digital markets (PL 2768/22) be approved?)

Both refer to same PL number (2768) and same subject: regulation of digital platforms/markets. Both ask if it should be approved. So they are equivalent. So relation: EQUIVALENT.

Provide JSON with reasoning: same bill, same question.
